command.krypton_hybrid.stats.reset: Krypton Hybrid network statistics have been reset.
command.krypton_hybrid.stats.gui_sent: Stats GUI snapshot sent. Open it on the client to view.
command.krypton_hybrid.packets.header: === Krypton Hybrid Packet Types (Top %1$s by %2$s | %3$s types tracked) ===
command.krypton_hybrid.mods.header: === Krypton Hybrid Mod Traffic (Top %1$s by %2$s | %3$s mods) ===
command.krypton_hybrid.packets.wire.head: Krypton packets by compressed wire bytes (top %1$s)
command.krypton_hybrid.mods.wire.header: Krypton mods by compressed wire bytes (top %1$s)
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.title: Krypton network
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.waiting: Waiting for the first snapshot from the server...
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.refresh.desc: The dashboard also refreshes itself every second while open.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.codec.title: Your connection's compression
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.codec.desc: What this connection actually negotiated with the server. ZSTD needs Krypton Hybrid with matching settings on both sides; otherwise vanilla ZLIB is used. Singleplayer is local and never compressed.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.live.title: Live data
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.live.desc: The dashboard refreshes every second while open; the HUD uses its own refresh interval.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.kpi.saving.desc: Share of outbound bytes removed by compression and Krypton's wire formats since the server started. The sparkline shows the live per-interval saving.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.kpi.out.desc: Bytes per second the server is putting on the wire right now, after compression. ~ marks a lifetime average shown until live data arrives.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.kpi.in.desc: Bytes per second the server is receiving from all players right now.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.kpi.pps.desc: Packets per second the server is sending right now.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.meter.bundle.des: Share of broadcast batches that were sent as one bundle instead of separate flushes. Higher is better.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.meter.coalesce.d: Share of packets dropped because a later packet in the same tick superseded them (movement, head rotation, entity data).
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.meter.coverage.d: Share of sent packets attributed to a packet type and mod. Low values mean the Mods tab misses part of the traffic.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.mods.col.name: Mod
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.mods.tip.title: #%1$s %2$s
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.status.title: Security layer
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.status.desc: Krypton's connection, handshake and packet guards. Controlled by security.enabled in the server config.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.rate_limited: New connections refused because their IP exceeded the connection budget or is quarantined.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.status_dropp: Server-list pings throttled per IP, usually scanners.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.legacy_dropp: Pre-1.7 server-list pings throttled per IP.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.handshake_re: Handshakes with an invalid protocol, address or next state.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.timeouts.des: Connections closed for staying too long in handshake or login.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.size_rejecte: Frames rejected for exceeding the size limit.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.read_limit.d: Strings or collections rejected for exceeding read limits.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.decomp_bombs: Packets whose claimed size or compression ratio looked like a decompression bomb.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.anomaly_even: Suspicious protocol behaviour scored by the anomaly detector.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.anomaly_disc: Connections closed after reaching the anomaly strike threshold.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.writes_dropp: Writes dropped because a peer stopped reading and its connection was closed.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.sec.watermark.de: Times a connection's outbound buffer passed the high watermark. Occasional hits during joins are normal.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.settings.theme.d: Color theme of the dashboard and HUD.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.settings.opacity: Lower values show more of the world behind the dashboard.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.settings.hud_vis: A small traffic card drawn over the game. Can also be bound to a key in Controls.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.settings.hud_anc: Screen corner the HUD sticks to.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.settings.hud_ref: How often the HUD asks the server for fresh stats.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.settings.hud_gra: Draw live rate trends next to the HUD values.
gui.krypton_hybrid.dash.settings.hud_top: Show the mod with the most traffic and its share.
